verdict.rationale: Neon documents an official serverless driver ([neon-docs-14]/[neon-docs-31]) purpose-built for querying over HTTP or WebSockets, designed for serverless/edge environments with short-lived connections, and complements it with documented connection pooling ([neon-docs-13]/[neon-docs-30]) and scale-to-zero behavior. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking or third-party validation of the HTTP/WebSocket driver specifically (community evidence covers general Neon experience but not this driver directly).
